d:
While super VR is all the rage.
Our very own high school girls have been lured into a world like a certain party game by the wiles of the Monokuma!
The girls walk carefully, but stop at an event square where bad status is always sprinkled, and they are immediately baptized.
From there, the chain of events continues, and eventually, the bad status is permanently irreversible.
Our lucky owner, who became worried, said "Oh... oh..." in the real world
The next thing you know, their bodies are being overwritten with information from their VR world bodies... but it's already too late...?

A deserted island where the sun shines on the sandy beach....
A group of super-sophomores wanders into what appears to be a board game...
They are forcibly lured into an event that looks like a board game.
They fall for Monokuma's plan...!
While many other students from other places are falling into the trap...
Finally, the girls...
